en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing ornate funerary and religious monuments inside a cathedral. Various stone and marble wall monuments with sculptures, inscriptions, and reliefs line the interior wall. At the bottom is printed red text identifying the scene, and there is cursive handwritten text across the lower margin. The style and wear suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.
